properties.name: DEST_IP
properties.description: Destination IP address recorded on outgoing audit log events. When unset, the audit logging filter falls back to the request's local address for each request.

properties.name: DEST_PORT
properties.description: Destination port recorded on outgoing audit log events. When unset, the audit logging filter falls back to the request's local port for each request.

properties.name: cache.duration-minutes
properties.description: Minutes an entry stays in the Caffeine cache after its last access before it expires. Backs the cache used for concept search results, concept counts, and facet lookups.

properties.name: cache.maximum-size
properties.description: Maximum number of entries the Caffeine cache can hold across the concept search, concept count, and facet caches before older entries are evicted.

properties.name: concept.tree.max_depth
properties.description: Upper bound on the depth request parameter accepted by the concept tree and ancestor endpoints. A requested depth outside 0 to this value makes the endpoint return a 400 response.

properties.name: dashboard.column-order
properties.description: Comma-separated list of dashboard column data element keys giving the display order of dashboard columns. A column whose key is not in this list is sorted after all listed columns, in its original order.

properties.name: dashboard.columns
properties.description: SpEL map literal, for example {abbreviation:'Abbreviation',name:'Name',clinvars:'Clinical Variables'}, pairing each dashboard column's data element key with its display label.

properties.name: dashboard.enable.bdc_hack
properties.description: When true, the dashboard endpoint returns a fixed set of BDC-specific columns and rows instead of the layout configured by dashboard.columns and dashboard.column-order.

properties.name: dashboard.enable.extra_details
properties.description: When false, concept detail responses skip adding parent concept details and return the concept unchanged.

properties.name: dashboard.layout.type
properties.description: Selects the dashboard drawer layout. When equal to default (case-insensitive), the dashboard drawer endpoints return data from the repository; any other value makes the full drawer endpoint return an empty list and the per-dataset drawer endpoint return nothing.

properties.name: dashboard.nonmeta-columns
properties.description: Comma-separated list of dashboard column data element keys that are not stored as dataset_meta key/value rows, so they are excluded from the metadata lookup query that builds dashboard rows.

properties.name: filtering.unfilterable_concepts
properties.description: Comma-separated list of concept_node_meta keys, for example stigmatized, whose matching concepts have their search rank multiplier set to zero. A matching concept stays in search results but sorts last instead of being excluded.

properties.name: metadata.no_show_list
properties.description: Comma-separated list of concept_node_meta keys excluded from concept metadata responses.
